example: Example run with fictional figures: Northbrook Trading, payroll clearing 2200 and the payroll liabilities, September 2026. The figures match the worked examples on the step-by-step page.

messages.text: Our payroll clearing account never gets back to zero. Can you reconcile it for September?
Yes. Before I read anything, I need eight answers. I ask them all at once, so the run does not stop again for each one.
list: Do you want me to use MosoFin, or will you upload files?
Which company? I propose the payroll accounts from your chart, and you confirm them.
How often do you pay each liability: monthly, semi-weekly or quarterly? I never assume this.
Please attach the payroll register for the period.
Please attach the bank statement for the period.
Up to what amount may I propose a write-off, and who approves it?
Do you have a statement of account from the tax authority or a benefit provider?

messages.text: Use MosoFin. Northbrook Trading, September. Federal taxes monthly by the 15th, 401(k) monthly by the 7th, state unemployment quarterly. Register and bank statement attached. Write-offs under $50, and I approve them. No statements of account.

messages.label: Checked the workspace and the company file
messages.summary: The agent can read your books. It cannot change them.

messages.text: Here is my plan. I reconcile **2200 Payroll clearing**, **2210 Federal payroll taxes**, **2230 401(k)** and **2240 State unemployment** for **September**. No payroll platform is connected, so your register gives the accrued side. Federal taxes and 401(k) are paid **monthly**, and state unemployment **quarterly**. I read twelve months of detail, from 1 October 2025, and tie net pay to your **bank statement**. Shall I start?

messages.label: Read the books in one batch
messages.summary: 10 reads in one batch. Nothing in your books changed.

messages.text: One check on scope first. **2250 Accrued payroll** also has payroll entries, **$2,500** at 30 September. It is not on your list. Do you want me to include it?
No. I review 2250 with the month-end accruals.
I list 2250 as excluded, with your reason. Now 2200. September's two pay runs each net to nil in 2200. So 2200 should hold nil, but it holds **$4,023.40**. Five items are stuck in it:

card.title: 2200 Payroll clearing at 30 Sep
head: Item
Amount
In 2200 since
Days
rows: Old balance, no detail in the twelve months
EE-03, direct deposit returned, not paid again
EE-05, final pay held in a dispute
JE-0912, memo “reclass contractor”, no pay run

messages.after: Four items, **$2,223.40**, are more than 60 days old. The oldest is from before October 2025. Only **$23.40** never cleared at any time in the twelve months. JE-0912 debits 6000 Wages, but no pay run is behind it. I show staff by reference only, never by name.

messages.text: 2210 looks fine at first. Its roll-forward ties to the books. But you pay monthly, so at a month end it should hold one month of taxes:
messages.after: The August deposit was due on Tue 15 Sep. Part of it is tax that you withheld from your staff. A person who willfully does not pay that can be personally liable. It needs a payment, not an entry.

messages.text: The money that did leave ties to the bank:

card.title: Bank and deposit ties
head: Check
Amount
Result
rows: Net pay, register against the bank statement
401(k) for August, paid Fri 4 Sep, due Mon 7 Sep
Federal taxes for August, due Tue 15 Sep

messages.after: The year-to-date test on 2210 also ties: 12,300 + 116,100 − 101,400 = 27,000. It uses the same closing balance, so it cannot show the unpaid August. Only your monthly cadence shows it.

messages.text: Can you write the whole $4,023.40 off to miscellaneous expense, so 2200 is clean?
No. **$1,050** of it is pay that two people did not get. You still owe it to them. I propose these entries instead:

card.title: Proposals
head: Item
Amount
Proposal
rows: Dr 2200, Cr 7900 Other income, under your $50
Dr 2200, Cr 2000 Accounts payable, if it is a contractor's bill
No entry until the dispute ends
A payment for you to make
Timing, due Thu 15 Oct, no entry
A refund to claim. Get the state's statement first

messages.after: After P1, P2 and P3, 2200 holds $1,150, the disputed final pay. P2 holds only if the older detail names no person. Your state's rules decide when unclaimed pay goes to the state. A person posts these entries. I do not.

messages.text: Your workpaper has a tab for each account, the summary, the bank tie-out, the proposed entries, the stale balances and the coverage.
messages.after: Do you want the workpaper as an Excel file? And do you want me to save your settings for next month?

messages.text: Here is **Payroll_Recs_2026-09_Northbrook Trading.xlsx**. I saved the account list, the cadences, the pay calendar, the payees and your write-off limit. I never save personal data, balances or ageings.
